description:
Use this when someone in Tennessee asks about term life insurance or a life insurance quote.
    Starts a term life estimate across many carriers and sends the shopper a 6 digit code.

    Term life only (ages 18 to 85). Requires the consent text from check_eligibility, read and
    agreed. date_of_birth is YYYY-MM-DD. death_benefit: 25000 to 10000000 dollars. health_class is
    the shopper's own estimate: 1 excellent health (preferred plus), 2 very good (preferred),
    3 good (standard plus), 4 average (standard). After verify_contact, call get_life_quotes.
    Prices are estimates, not offers. To apply, use request_agent.
name: start_life_quote
title: Start a term life insurance estimate
